name: cheapearth9's apps
subtitle: VacuumTube, AirBrowser and more
description: Sideloadable iOS apps built on GitHub by cheapearth9. They are unsigned: AltStore / SideStore sign them with your own Apple ID.

apps.name: VacuumTube
apps.subtitle: YouTube TV, no ads
apps.description: An unofficial iOS port of VacuumTube: the regular YouTube TV interface with an ad blocker and VacuumTube's settings menu. Plug in an HDMI adapter or use AirPlay and YouTube appears on that screen; the iPad or iPhone becomes the remote. External keyboards work too.

apps.name: AirBrowser
apps.subtitle: Browser for your HDMI / AirPlay screen
apps.description: A browser that can put pages on a connected HDMI or AirPlay display while the iPad or iPhone stays the controller.
